name: Mokosh
subtitle: Lady of Waters
description: This hero story is yet to be revealed.
lore: Vyraj’s goddess of the earth, the waters, and fertility, Mokosh eschews the politics of pantheons and the wars of Realms. She prefers to focus on those who call upon her with proper reverence, ensuring bountiful harvests and healthy offspring where peace lingers. Where violence holds sway, she offers the barest hints of the bounty she can provide if only the bloodshed might end.
divinity_generator: Gain [10] Divinity when an ally is healed.

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Attunement Multiplier +25%, Armor Multiplier +15%, Weapon Multiplier +15%

skills.name: Cradle of the Earth
skills.description: Place [mechanic:radiance-ii] and [mechanic:stalwart] on a target ally for 2 turns. If the target is aligned with Order, also place [mechanic:def-up-ii] on the target for 2 turns. If the target is aligned with Chaos, place [mechanic:atk-up-ii] on the target for 2 turns.

skills.name: Woven Strength
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 220%ATK and increase the Turn Meter and Divinity of the ally with the highest ATK by 5%.

skills.name: Guardian Mother
skills.description: Revive 1 defeated ally with 30% HP and 30% Turn Meter and place [Pheonix] on the target for 1 turn.

skills.name: Harvest Cycle
skills.description: When any enemy is defeated, Heal 1500%INIT all allies and increase their Turn Meter by 20%.
skills.awakening_bonus: When an enemy is revived, increase all allies Divinity by 10%.

imprint_passive: When any enemy is defeated, Heal 1500%INIT this hero and increase Turn Meter by 10%.
